tagline: 柯尼卡数码相机，2002 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于2002年推出的数码相机。配备Konica 3× zoom lens f=5.6-16.8mm F2.8-4.9 with macro setting (15cm distance in wide angle mode)。autofocus。

specs.镜头: Konica 3× zoom lens f=5.6-16.8mm F2.8-4.9 with macro setting (15cm distance in wide angle mode)
specs.曝光测光: spot-photometer controlled programmed, speeds 1/4 to 1/2000 sec
specs.闪光灯: built-in, reaches as far as 3m only in wide angle mode
specs.英文简介: The Konica Revio KD-3300 is a digital compact camera.
